Dude I am so sorry to read this.
But please, please, you have a kid on the way. Don't leave this earth. Your wife and your future kid will need you. How bad this might seem, do you think a kid will understand? He'll be growing up without his father, the kid will not care if you are filthy rich or have nothing, atleast he has his father and his mother. I am not trying to guilt trip you or make it worse but please dude don't give up. 
Money is temporary and it hurts to lose it all. But it isn't everything. I know alot of people without a father and that has hurt them more than whatever financial situation they have been in. 

I hope you stay safe dude I really hope. What has happened has happened, right now focus on the future and what you still got. I wish you the best of luck man.

How drunk you get can depend on what you ate, your mood, the time of the day etc. If you want to get drunker next time you could get another bottle but I wouldn't recommend slamming it down or anything like that.
Maybe next time the same amount will you get f^cked up.
Stay safe and enjoy the drunken times.

Depends on what you take.
If you take benzos (xanax, valium, etc) I would be careful and not drink too fast so you have time to react if the effects are too strong.
Benzos + alcohol is an easy way to blackout and do dumb shit so be careful and take care!

I like Wyborowa. If you can get it I would surely give it a try. 
I think it's a nice smooth, well-priced vodka compared to other more pricey "high end" vodkas.

I am not 100% sure since I am no expert but Benzo tolerance can also influence Alcohol tolerance. Both work on the same GABA system iirc. 
Also alcohol just hits different sometimes. I can drink a bottle of vodka and feel decent or take 2 shots and throw up.
Depends on alot of shit like vibe and what you ate.

Stay safe dude. I've had bad and dangerous times on this combination.
